title: Crepuscular Sunset Rays
subtitle: Mie Volumetric Scattering & Ocean Wave Glitter Path
description: Simulation of atmospheric crepuscular sunbeams (God rays) piercing cloud gaps over a dusk ocean. Implements forward Mie photon scattering, radial occlusion shadow volumes, and a shimmering Gerstner wave specular glitter path on the water horizon.
mathNotation: I(r, \theta) = I_0 e^{-\sigma r} P(\theta) \cdot \mathcal{O}(\theta, t), \quad S(x, y) = e^{-\frac{(x - x_{\text{sun}})^2}{2\sigma_x^2}} \cdot \max(0, \nabla \eta \cdot \mathbf{L})^m
formulaCompact: I(r,θ) = I_0 exp(-σr) P(θ) · [Σ A_k cos(f_k θ + ω_k t)]^p,  glitter = exp(-Δx²/2w²) · (N · L)^m

parameters.label: Ray Radiance
parameters.description: Photon intensity of volumetric sunbeam shafts

parameters.label: Cloud Occlusion
parameters.description: Density and turbulence of cloud silhouette gaps

parameters.label: Ocean Glitter
parameters.description: Horizontal spread of the specular sunlight path on wave crests

parameters.description: Vertical position of the solar source relative to horizon
